name: attention_fp8_pv_wgmma_v1
hypothesis: Keep both FP8 operands for WGMMA PV, scale probabilities by 2^8 per pinned FA3 precision behavior, and remove the per-tile V FP8-to-FP16 conversion in full-context verification.
decision_reason: Four H200 compiles failed in Triton ConvertNVGPUToLLVM before timing. NVIDIA PTX documents that WGMMA transpose is unsupported for FP8 operands; current QK and PV operands require transposed shared descriptors. A usable design would need a data-layout rewrite, not this direct dtype swap.
